findings.claim: Vale 在 20-F 自述：可使用較低品位鐵礦的技術可能降低其高品位產品組合的相對使用價值，對鐵礦產品需求與溢價造成負面影響；公司持續監控顛覆性技術。
findings.excerpt: Technologies that can allow the competitive use of lower grade iron ores could reduce the relative value in use of our higher-grade portfolio and have a negative impact on the demand and premium of our iron ore products. We continue to monitor disruptive technologies and market trends to deliver appropriate supply answers.

findings.claim: S&P Global 2026 Q1 亞洲鎳市場回顧：買方預期 NMC 電池需求upside有限，電池廠轉向無鎳 LFP。
findings.source: S&P Global Commodity Insights trade review

findings.claim: Mysteel：Vale Indonesia 管理層稱鎳仍有成長空間，LFP 滲透率已逾全球電動車電池 55%。
findings.excerpt: On demand, Bernardus said nickel still has room to grow despite rising LFP battery penetration, which now exceeds 55% of global EV batteries. Outside China, however, about 80% of EV batteries still use nickel-based chemistry.

findings.claim: IEEFA 報告：新製程組合可讓 DRI 使用 62-65% 一般品位鐵礦，減少對高品位礦需求。
